Remove features also found in the blanks

blankCorrection.Rd

Which samples are blanks is given in the sample table. The features found both in samples and blanks are removed from the alignment table, unless the intensity in the samples is higher than the blank by the intensityFactor.

Usage 

blankCorrection(
  alignment,
  samplels,
  intensityFactor = 10,
  deleteGrouped = TRUE
)

Arguments

alignment

Alignment table (matrix)

samplels

sample table

intensityFactor

Intensity difference between samples and blanks beyond which features are not deleted

deleteGrouped

If true (default) then when a blank feature is found, it will be removed along with the whole component group (isotopologues, adducts, in-source fragments)

Value

An alignment table with rows removed

Details

If more than one blank sample exists then the highest intensity will be used for the comparison.
